description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest"
                      name="Scoring request"

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankLevel2Result"
                      name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchFrontendLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend interaction" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Frontend">

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FrontendSoftware" name="Frontend">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendFrontendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForBank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchFrontendImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FrontendImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchFrontendDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayDelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchFrontendLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FrontendLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Frontend" name="Clerk begins scoring request"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring via frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFrontendRequest" name="Send scoring request to banking system" messageRef="Message_FrontendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForBank" name="Wait for banking system response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchFrontendImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchFrontendDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendDelay" messageRef="Message_FrontendDelay"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchFrontendLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Task_SendFrontendRequest"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForBank" targetRef="Event_CatchFrontendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForBank" targetRef="Event_CatchFrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchFrontendImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_7" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="End_FrontendImmediateResult"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_9" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchFrontendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_10" sourceRef="Event_CatchFrontendLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_11" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="End_FrontendLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAgencyRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_AgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgency" name="Wait for agency response"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchAgencyDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" name="Send scoring result to frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankLevel2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result sent to frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Event_CatchAgencyDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchAgencyDelay" targetRef="Task_SendFrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyRequest"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAgencyDelay" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_AgencyDelay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_AgencyImmediateResult"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_AgencyLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
